question: Did they experiment with this new dataset?
title: ZuCo 2.0: A Dataset of Physiological Recordings During Natural Reading and Annotation
answer_rationale: The document explicitly states that ZuCo 2.0 was recorded and preprocessed as a new dataset to analyze differences in cognitive processing between natural reading and annotation, and that experiments were conducted with 18 participants reading 739 sentences under two different paradigms (normal reading and task-specific annotation).
